name: linear_not_consumed
condition: a linear value is still owned at an exit of its scope on some path, or a linear temporary is not consumed by the end of its statement. In a generic body, a T without Discard counts as linear
fix: if the type has exactly one consuming function with no other parameters and no error type, insert defer { x.f(); } after the declaration; otherwise the message lists the candidates. In a generic body, add the bound Discard instead, if the value is a T
